title: Late-Renewal Premium Rating for Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
**Rating rule.** The new term of a Rental Property Service Contracts contract renewed late, within its late-renewal grace period, is priced as one annual premium billed on the late renewal date.

The late-renewal premium is twelve times the contract's base monthly amount, which is the tier's monthly premium plus the tier's additional-unit premium for each unit beyond the first, reduced first by the tier's pay-in-full discount rate and then by the portfolio discount rate recorded on the expired term's annual premium charge, the two reductions multiplying, and rounded to the cent once at the end.

**The portfolio rate.** For a late renewal the portfolio discount rate recorded on the expired term's annual premium charge is carried into the new term instead of counting the portfolio again, and only for such a late renewal; every other renewal remains under the renewal and portfolio discount terms.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Tier and unit count | the contract |
| Monthly premium, additional-unit premium and pay-in-full discount rate | the product's premium rate card, for the contract's tier |
| Portfolio discount rate | the expired term's annual premium charge in the billing history |

## Worked examples (hypothetical contracts)

| Contract | Base monthly amount | Twelve times | Reduced by the pay-in-full rate 0.10 | Reduced by the carried portfolio rate | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Rental Combo, one unit, carried rate 0.05 | $64.99 | $779.88 | $701.892 | $666.7974 | **$666.80** |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo, three units, carried rate 0.00 | $149.97 | $1799.64 | $1619.676 | $1619.676 | **$1619.68** |
| Bridgewell Rental Appliance, one unit, carried rate 0.10 | $42.99 | $515.88 | $464.292 | $417.8628 | **$417.86** |

The rounding is taken once, on the final figure.
